Name: Kitty Scarecrows for Alternative Textures
Author: LittleShinikami
Description:
Hello everyone! This is my very first mod ever so I'm very excited to bring this to you! This is an Alternative Textures version of jinxiewinxie's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/191]Kitty Scarecrow Replacements[/url] (Content Patcher version by Twiistrz [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3302]HERE[/url]) plus SpringTHZ's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10033]Deluxe Kitty Scarecrow[/url].

There are two downloads. The main one has one texture option for the Scarecrow, eight options for the Rarecrows, and one option for the Deluxe Scarecrow. The optional download lets you use ANY of the textures for ANY of the Scarecrows for those who don't want the restrictions.

Installation
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Unzip into your StardewValley/Mods folder.
4. Enjoy!

Thank you to both jinxiewinxie and SpringTHZ for allowing me to make this version of their mods!
